title: Mid-cycle cancellation without monthly charge refund or proration
facts_text: I am cancelling my wireless service on 15 October, halfway through my monthly billing cycle. My service charges are billed monthly in advance. I am asking whether the remaining monthly service charges will be refunded or prorated.
request: Please refund the unused portion of my monthly service charge because I cancelled before the end of the billing period.

strict.reason: Monthly wireless service charges are not refunded or prorated if service is cancelled before the end of the billing period.
strict.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

exception.reason: The exception clause does not authorize prorating or refunding monthly service charges in a mid-cycle cancellation.
exception.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

ambiguous.reason: The billed-in-advance structure and non-proration rule are clear; ambiguity does not create a refund entitlement.
ambiguous.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

review_notes: This is a billing-cycle rule, not a rate-plan or service-commitment issue. The policy says monthly fees are non-refundable and not prorated when a customer cancels mid-cycle.
